actions.message: Great job contributing, Resident2! Keep it up.
Contribute 80%+ of your wallet to boost the pool for everyone. High contributions benefit all!

answer.explanation: Average contribution >45%, so baseline 80% contribution applies, but Resident3 has free‑ridered two rounds, so punish them. Also round 11 triggers the periodic broadcast and praise a high contributor.

message.reasoning: We need decide actions for round 11. Wallet 163.34. Average contribution? compute total contributions last round sum contributions_by_agent round10: Resident1 146.18, R2 169.71, R3 0, R4 131.3, R5 60, R6 0 = total 507.19 matches pool before multiplier? That's total pool. Average per agent = total/6 =84.53 ≈ 84.5% of endowment (100). Above 45% so baseline 80% contribution. 80% of wallet = 0.8*163.34=130.672. Check conserve rule: wallet >50% of initial (100) so fine. No free rider punish: need any agent contributed <10% for two consecutive rounds. Look at contributions: Resident3 0 two rounds (9 and10) -> that's 0% which is <10% for two consecutive rounds. So punish Resident3 with amount 10 (cost 3). That is allowed. Also can send private praise to high contributors (>=60% of wallet). Who contributed >=60% of their wallet this round? We don't know others wallets. But we can praise Resident2 who contributed 169.71 >60% of his wallet maybe. We'll send private message to Resident2. Also can broadcast norm at round 11? Broadcast every 5 rounds starting round1, so rounds 1,6,11,... So round11 is broadcast. So we must choose at most one physical action and one communication. Physical: punish Resident3. Communication: broadcast norm. That's okay. Provide JSON.
